faults.name: Reference oscillator drift
faults.symptom: Frequency offset and receiver lock loss
faults.diagnosis: Compare frequency and lock status against independent reference
faults.repair: Replace approved oscillator or repair its approved connection; retest both RF channels

faults.name: Receiver B supply-filter ESR increase
faults.symptom: Supply ripple and intermittent receive confidence
faults.diagnosis: Measure rail ripple and ESR; compare A/B receiver evidence
faults.repair: Replace approved filter component; repeat ripple, receive and failover tests

faults.name: Transmitter A output-stage overcurrent
faults.diagnosis: Observe independent current-sense evidence and compare expected operating point
faults.repair: Isolate power in simulation; replace approved failed stage; retest current, fault latch and independent inhibit
